title: Load Unity Catalog tables into PyTorch on AI Runtime (Beta)
body: `UCDataset` streams rows from Unity Catalog tables directly into PyTorch training loops on AI Runtime, without Spark or a SQL warehouse. It applies filter expressions and deletion vectors as it reads, and splits the matching rows across GPUs and data loader workers. See [Load Unity Catalog tables into PyTorch with `UCDataset`](/aws/en/machine-learning/ai-runtime/develop-workloads/load-uc-tables).
